=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1103 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op detection regex is anchored to the full line, so legitimate success messages embedded in longer output will be missed.
  WHY: This changes previous substring-style matching into a stricter full-line match, creating false negatives that can trigger unnecessary re-issues or failures.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:131-132 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The consolidator still runs with `--full-auto` and lacks explicit `--sandbox read-only`, so it can write to the workspace.
  WHY: Workspace writes in the consolidation phase can pollute the pre-editor snapshot and recreate the `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive this PR is meant to fix.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:82-85 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trap uses `rmdir` on `${consolidator_codex_root}` and silently ignores failures.
  WHY: If the directory is not empty, cleanup can fail and leave temporary directories behind, which is an operational hygiene issue.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:983-997,1028-1043 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The rollback-preservation logic can leave `LAST_SEEN_ITERATION` ahead of the current iteration in replay/rollback scenarios.
  WHY: The second loop preserves prior `last_seen` without clamping it to the current `ITERATION`, which can produce inconsistent ledger state.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1103 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Success-no-op regex changed from substring matching to full-line matching with anchors (`^` and `$`).
  WHY: This will miss legitimate success messages embedded in longer sentences and can trigger unnecessary re-issues or failure handling.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:~82-85 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Cleanup trap uses `rmdir` on `${consolidator_codex_root}` which may fail if the directory is not empty.
  WHY: The `|| true` suppresses errors but does not fix the resource leak, so temporary directories can accumulate over time.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:~132 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Consolidator still runs with `--full-auto` which grants workspace-write access.
  WHY: If the consolidator writes to workspace files, those writes can pollute the pre-editor snapshot and recreate the `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:~132 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Missing `--sandbox read-only` flag on consolidator invocation.
  WHY: Without explicit read-only sandboxing, the consolidator could potentially write to the workspace even without `--full-auto`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:132 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The consolidator `codex exec` is missing `--sandbox read-only` and `--ask-for-approval never`.
  WHY: Although the consolidator uses an isolated `consolidator_codex_home`, it still has write access to the repository workspace and can cause the same `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1103 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new success-no-op detection regex is anchored to the full line and expects specific leading formatting.
  WHY: If the model returns the success phrase with a different prefix, the regex fails to match and a legitimate no-op is misclassified.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:1031-1035 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Iteration-rollback logic for `LAST_SEEN_ITERATION` can allow `last_seen` to be less than `first_seen` if `ITERATION` is rolled back below `first_seen`.
  WHY: Setting `last_seen="${ITERATION}"` first and only updating if `prior_last_seen` is greater can create an illegal ledger state after rollback.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:~131 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The consolidator script still uses `--full-auto`, which implies workspace-write sandbox access.
  WHY: Unlike the reviewers, the consolidator was missed and can still write to workspace files, polluting the pre-editor snapshot and causing the `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:983-997 and 1028-1043 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The rollback preservation logic for `LAST_SEEN_ITERATION` can leave `LAST_SEEN` in the future relative to the current iteration.
  WHY: If the prior ledger had a higher `LAST_SEEN_ITERATION` than the current rollback iteration, the logic preserves that future value and creates confusing ledger state.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:82-85 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The trap cleanup uses `rmdir` and silently ignores failures.
  WHY: If the directory is not empty, cleanup can fail and temp directories may accumulate on long-running runners.
